summary.text: Trojan whom Achilles smote full upon the neck with a thrust of his spear when the son of Peleus raged through the ranks — Apollodorus counts Dryops among the many sons whom Priam begot by other women.

story.text: So saying Achilles smote Dryops full upon the neck with a thrust of his spear, and he fell down before his feet. But he left him there, and stayed from fight Demuchus, Philetor's son, a valiant man and tall.
